voxy.config.title: Voxy
voxy.config.general.serviceThreads.toolt: Number of threads the ServiceThreadPool can use
voxy.config.general.useSodiumBuilder.too: Uses sodium builder threads as part of voxys thread pool, can reduce stuttering and lag when moving quickly at high render distance
voxy.config.general.ingest.tooltip: Enables or disables voxies ability to convert new chunks into LoDs
voxy.config.general.renderer_backend.too: Selects Voxy's renderer. Native uses Voxy's Vulkan/OpenGL renderer. Blaze3D uses Minecraft's public rendering API.
voxy.confirm.iris_blaze3d.title: Iris shaderpack active
voxy.confirm.iris_blaze3d.message:
Blaze3D may have visual issues with this Iris shaderpack.

Recommended: Use Native.
voxy.config.general.subDivisionSize.tool: Maximum screen-space size before subdividing to a finer LoD. Smaller values increase quality and memory use.
voxy.config.general.renderDistance.toolt: Render distance of voxy in chunks
voxy.config.general.blaze3d_memory_estim: Estimated Blaze3D requirement: about %s of free VRAM and %s of free RAM. This includes expanded Cortex geometry and transition staging.
This exceeds Blaze3D's 8 GiB geometry safety limit; it will retain coarser LoDs where necessary instead of stopping or leaving holes.
voxy.config.general.environmental_fog.to: Configures the environmental fog and fade effects
voxy.config.general.ssao_mode.tooltip: The mode used for screenspace ambient occlusion (Auto attempts to pick the best option while reducing performance impact)
